about: The only cron job names cron.run may carry (spec 4.1 job_name). Exactly the Index digest names and the ZZZ managed job name; install/tests/av_events_state.test.ts fails if they drift. A name is reported only with its verified installed job id. Any other job's name is null: a participant can have the agent schedule anything, and cron.run is kept without research consent (spec 2.2).
